yaml.title: Sponsor a tree
yaml.subtitle: Join the conservation of the La Constancia Arboretum

markdown.markdown:
```{=html}
Arboretum Home The Collection Map Self-guided tour Wellbeing Visit Sponsor a tree Donate Companies Contact Book a visit Español ▸
``` Every tree in the arboretum has a story. **By sponsoring a specimen you help care for it, study it and share it** — and you leave your mark on a living being that can accompany several generations. It is a beautiful way to celebrate a date, honour someone, or simply be part of a conservation project. ::: grid ::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center} ### 1. Choose your tree Browse the [species catalogue](catalogue.html) or the [map](map.html) and pick the specimen you like most. ::: ::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center} ### 2. Sponsor it Write to us and we arrange the sponsorship. You can do it in your own name, as a **gift**, or in **honour** of someone. ::: ::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center} ### 3. Leave your mark Your name (or that of the person honoured) appears on the **tree's profile**, and you can visit it whenever you like. ::: ::: ## Sponsorship levels ::: grid ::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm} ### 🌱 Friend of the Arboretum - Your name on the tree's profile - Digital sponsorship certificate - Arboretum news ::: ::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm style="border-top:3px solid #1E4A38;"} ### Sponsor - Everything above - Your name also on the **physical label** beside the tree - A guided visit for two people ::: ::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm} ### 🌲 Benefactor - Everything above - Featured recognition on the website - Ideal for **companies** or institutions ::: ::: ::: {.callout-note} Amounts and benefits are a starting point, to be tailored to each project. ::: ## A gift with roots Looking for a different gift? Sponsoring a tree is an original and meaningful present for birthdays, weddings, births, or to remember a loved one. We provide a **personalized certificate** with the tree's name and location. ## I want to sponsor a tree Write to us and we'll walk you through the steps: - Email: [laconstanciaargentina@gmail.com](mailto:laconstanciaargentina@gmail.com) - 📱 WhatsApp: [+54 9 11 5736 0940](https://wa.me/5491157360940) - Instagram: [@laconstanciadebiocca](https://instagram.com/laconstanciadebiocca) [See available trees →](catalogue.html){.btn .btn-success role="button"} --- *Your contribution goes towards the care, study and outreach of the natural heritage of Estancia La Constancia.*
